instruction: When searching in Vim, I want the matched text to be highlighted. Find instructions online for enabling search highlighting in Vim and apply this configuration permanently.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for how to enable search highlighting in Vim, then editing ~/.vimrc to add 'set hlsearch' or 'set hls'. The evaluator verifies the .vimrc file contains the search highlighting setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks ~/.vimrc for permanent Vim configuration
Script properly verifies presence of 'set hlsearch' or 'set hls' settings
Regex pattern has a subtle flaw: '^set hlsearch\|^set hls' - the second alternative 'set hls' is not anchored to line start due to bash grep regex precedence
Missing edge case: won't detect commented-out settings (e.g., '" set hlsearch')
Missing edge case: won't detect conflicting 'set nohlsearch' or 'set nohls' that would disable highlighting
Missing edge case: limited handling of whitespace variations (e.g., indented lines or extra spaces)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix regex pattern in eval_vim_hlsearch.sh to: grep -qE '^\s*set\s+(hlsearch|hls)\s*$' for proper anchoring and whitespace handling
Add check to exclude commented lines: grep -v '^\s*"' before checking for hlsearch
Consider checking for 'set nohlsearch' or 'set nohls' and fail if found, as these would disable the feature
Add test to verify the setting is not commented out and is an active configuration line
